title: Stack Nudge dedupe marker: match the gh pr view login, not the REST bot login
answers: stack nudge comment posted again on every PR edit
duplicate bot comment on stacked PR description edit
why does the nudge marker check never match
body:
Symptom: every edit of a PR description that contains the stacked PR phrase adds another "GitHub now supports stacked pull requests" comment.
Root cause: .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge, the `already_nudged` step, runs a jq filter over `gh pr view --json comments` that checks `.author.login == "github-actions"` and the `<!-- mlflow-stack-nudge -->` marker in the body.
Fix pattern: when reading bot-authored comments through `gh pr view`, compare against the GraphQL-form login `github-actions`. The REST comments API reports the same author as `github-actions[bot]` under `.user.login`, so comparing that string against the `gh pr view` output never matches.
Constraint: this applies only to the `gh pr view --json comments` path. If the check is moved to `gh api` REST, compare `.user.login` to `github-actions[bot]` instead.
Constraint: the marker string must stay identical in the posted body and in the dedupe filter.
applies: Any workflow that uses a comment marker to deduplicate bot comments via gh CLI.
says: The pull request bot posts duplicate stacked pull request comments every time I edit the description.
Editing a stacked pull request description triggers another automated tip comment.
Stop the automated stack advice comment from repeating whenever the description changes.
The stacked pull request reminder should only appear once on a pull request.
Multiple identical bot messages about native stacks keep cluttering the discussion thread.
search: In .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:already_nudged, deduplicating bot comments via gh pr view --json comments requires matching .author.login against github-actions rather than github-actions[bot]. The gh pr view command outputs GraphQL-formatted logins, whereas the REST API reports .user.login as github-actions[bot]. If the check moves to gh api REST, compare .user.login to github-actions[bot] instead, and keep the <!-- mlflow-stack-nudge --> marker string identical in both the posted body and the filter.
